outputs.explanation: Panel A is a photograph (ex vivo lung images), not a plot showing averages.
Bar graph of ICG mean fluorescence intensity shows mean ± SD bars with individual data points (colored dots) overlaid for each mouse in both groups.
Panel C consists of micrograph/spatial images (H&E, ICG, RNAscope, spatial transcriptomics plots), not an averaged data plot.
GSEA enrichment plots are line plots, which are exempt from requiring individual data points.
Bar graph showing log2 fold change of M2/TAM genes displays only bars with associated p-values; no individual data points are overlaid to show underlying variability.
Panel F shows fluorescence and IHC micrograph images, not an averaged data plot.
